title: Agent policy (.claude/agent-policy.json)
description: Per-repository policy for the agent workflows in baseten/agent-skills. Every key is optional; an absent key takes the default shown. Each key names the skills that read it, and each of those skills owns what the key means.

$schema.description: Points editors and agents at this schema.

concurrent-workers.description: Workers running at once. Read by: backlog-orchestrator.

concurrent-open-prs.description: This run's open PRs plus implementation workers in flight; a count, freed on merge or close. Read by: backlog-orchestrator.

new-issue-budget.description: New issues one invocation may start; a spend ceiling no merge restores. Read by: backlog-orchestrator.

implementation-attempts.description: Attempts per issue before it goes to the owner. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue.

model-escalations.description: Strongest-model implementation escalations per issue. Read by: backlog-orchestrator.

ci-repair-cycles.description: Pushed CI repair passes per PR. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue.

review-repair-cycles.description: Pushed review repair passes per PR; review rounds are not counted. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue.

finding-repair-cycles.description: Pushed settle-finding repair passes per PR. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue.

repair-model-escalations.description: Repair rounds per PR that may run on the strongest model. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue.

lost-worker-redispatches.description: Redispatches per issue after a worker is lost. Read by: backlog-orchestrator.

conductor-clear-at.description: Percent of the conductor session's max_tokens at which it proposes a context clear to the operator. Absent or null: the lower of 50% of max_tokens and 60% of the session's auto-compact threshold. Read by: conductor.

conductor-repositories.description: The repositories, as owner/name, one conductor coordinates, read from the conductor's home repository: the one it was invoked on. Absent or null: that repository alone. Read by: conductor.

conductor-ledger.description: Where the conductor keeps its ledger, in fallback order: github-issue (a [PLAN] issue in the home repository), tracker-document (a document on the feature's tracker project), document-store-page (a page in the connected document store). The first the session can write is used. Absent or null: github-issue alone. Read by: conductor.

issues.description: File every owner step as a [Manual] issue. Off by default: owner steps are reported where the run reports, and never filed.

epic.description: The issue number of this repository's manual-steps epic. null: found by title, or created.

runbooks.description: Repository paths of the runbooks owner steps follow; they win over everything here.

ssh-user.description: The user SSH reaches the live server as. null: the deploy user the runbooks name.

sudo.description: Whether that user may run sudo.

root-console.description: The provider web console root steps run in. hetzner, other and null take the script route.

specifics.description: Recorded server specifics for owner steps: paths, restart commands, commands never to run. Never a secret.

manual-steps.description: Per-repository values for owner steps: whether they are filed as [Manual] issues (opt-in), under which epic, and how the live server is reached. Absent or null: nothing filed, and owner-steps' server-access defaults. Never a secret. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, conductor, owner-steps.

auto-request-settle.description: Offer the settle-outstanding-decisions walkthrough when a run settles. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue.

auto-resolve-comments.description: Post and resolve a repaired thread a person is in without waiting for approval; off, that reply is held for the owner and the thread left open. Threads only bots are in are unaffected. Only this file can turn it on. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue, resolve-pr-comment.

ci-mode.description: How a PR's CI is spent. per-pr: CI runs as pushes trigger it. deferred: CI is deferred until the PR is quiescent on its head, then run once, and a stale green is re-checked at the merge gate only where the base's changes overlap the PR's files (supervise-prs, Deferred CI). integration-branch: a backlog-orchestrator run's issue PRs target an integration branch the run creates for itself (integration-branch-prefix), carry [skip ci], are gated on a tiered local gate instead of CI and may merge into that branch through the merge gate, and one PR from it into the default branch runs CI on opening and once per budgeted repair (supervise-prs, Integration-branch CI); implement-issue applies per-pr there. Each mode has effect only where its repository preconditions hold. Only this file sets a mode other than per-pr. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue, conductor.

integration-branch-prefix.description: Prefix of the branch a backlog-orchestrator run under ci-mode integration-branch creates for itself: the prefix plus the run's manifest identifier, one branch per run, deleted once its integration PR merges. Ignored under any other ci-mode. Only this file sets it. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, conductor.

branch-update.description: How a run brings a stale PR branch up to its base: rebase with a pinned force-with-lease, or merge the base in. A merge is kept wherever a rule needs one (rules/agent-policy.md, Branch updates); never the merge method or the integration branch. An invocation may set merge only; a value outside the enum resolves to merge. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue, settle-and-merge, supervise-prs.

minimize-ci-runs.description: Deprecated alias: true is ci-mode deferred, false is per-pr. true beside a ci-mode other than deferred resolves the repository to per-pr, reported. Only this file turns it on. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue.

review-defer-severity.description: Severity at or below which an automated reviewer's repairable finding is filed as a follow-up issue and its thread resolved, instead of repaired in the PR: no push, no review cycle, no new round. P0, P1, security findings, findings without a severity label, threads a person is in and regressions of the PR's own earlier repair are repaired as before (resolve-pr-comment, Findings deferred to a follow-up). Only this file turns it on. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue.

publish-triggers-review.description: Publishing a draft starts an automated review in this repository, so a fresh review round is required after a publish before the merge gate opens. Off, publishing is inert unless the repository's CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or a ready_for_review workflow says otherwise (settle-and-merge, Merge behavior). Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue.

auto-merge.description: Let implementation PRs merge through the invariant 12 merge gate, which settle-and-merge defines. Only this file can turn it on. On, it also lets a run edit the body of a published PR it governs. Read by: backlog-orchestrator, implement-issue, conductor.

auto-merge-dependencies.description: Let dependency PRs merge: triage-cleared minor/patch bumps on CI alone; majors and bumps needing application changes after a clean automated review. Only this file can turn it on. On, it also lets a run edit the body of a published dependency PR it governs. Read by: npm-dependency-upgrade-orchestrator.
